we developed AraVib, a software program for analyzing the vibrational characteristics of Arabidopsis stem and its extended version AraVibS for high-throughput mutant screening.

we developed Python-based programs, AraVib and AraVibS for the high-through-put analysis of Arabidopsis stem free vibrations, which can be applied to the screening of mutants with altered mechanical proper- ties, and we identified nst1 n st3 and wrky12 mutants by employing only videos of stem vibrations in addition to two growth traits.
we developed a new system to screen for mutants of plant stem mechanical properties by using only two growth traits and stem vibration videos.

the high-throughput identification of mutants with altered mechanical property in plants, and our system is expected to contribute to the development of new plant materials.
